name: The Reading Room
description: Green lamps pool light on long tables. Every chair faces the iron door at the far end.

east.blocked_text: The iron door is locked. Pell keeps the key.

name: The Stacks
description: Shelves climb into the dark. Somewhere above, a ladder creaks on its rail.

name: The Map Vault
description:
Flat drawers line the walls, each labelled in Pell's careful hand. One drawer stands open, waiting for the map.

Your visit to the archive is complete.

west.blocked_text: The iron door has swung shut.
